producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 110 BPM, 4/4, F# minor. Mid-tempo, pumping and heroic, darker than nostalgia usually is.

VOICE: Instrumental. A robotic arcade-machine voice says three short phrases, lo-fi and slightly pitched down.

INSTRUMENTS: A pumping, sidechained analogue synth bass, a four-on-the-floor kick with a big gated snare, bright sixteenth-note arpeggios, a heroic sawtooth lead synth, electronic toms, a choir pad, 8-bit chip sounds, cabinet hum, a coin drop and a power switch.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, hum, coin and jingle. 0:14 Sample. 0:18 Section A. 0:44 Section B. 1:10 Melody. 1:40 Sample. 1:46 Break. 2:00 Section C. 2:24 Melody, doubled. 2:54 Sample. 3:00 Outro, jingle slows, switch at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2014 dark synthwave: thick analogue bass, bright digital arpeggios, 1980s gated drums, modern loudness.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The lead melody entering at 1:10.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original imagines a club in a future city. This looks back instead, to the arcades of the 1980s, and finds the machines still running after everyone grew up and left.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Nostalgic, pumped up, wistful, switched off.
